sentences.en: A International trade is growing at a startling pace.
sentences.zh: 国际贸易正在以惊人的速度增长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: While the global economy has been expanding at a bit over 3% a year, the volume of trade has been rising at a compound annual rate of about twice that.
sentences.zh: 虽然全球经济以每年略高于3%的速度增长,但贸易量却以每年两倍的复合增长率增长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Foreign products, from meat to machinery, play a more important role in almost every economy in the world, and foreign markets now tempt businesses that never much worried about sales beyond their nation’s borders.
sentences.zh: 外国产品从肉类到机械,在世界几乎每一个经济体中都起着更为重要的作用,外国市场现在吸引了从未担心过超出本国边界销售的企业。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B What lies behind this explosion in international commerce?
sentences.zh: B 国际商业的这一爆炸背后的背后原因是什么?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The general worldwide decline in trade barriers, such as customs duties and import quotas, is surely one explanation.
sentences.zh: 关税和进口配额等贸易壁垒在全世界普遍下降,这肯定是一种解释。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The economic opening of countries that have traditionally been minor players is another.
sentences.zh: 传统上是次要角色的国家的经济开放是另一个因素。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But one force behind the import-export boom has passed all but unnoticed: the rapidly falling cost of getting goods to market.
sentences.zh: 但进出口繁荣背后的一股力量却已经过去了,但并没有被人们注意到:让货物进入市场的成本迅速下降。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Theoretically, in the world of trade, shipping costs do not matter.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲,在贸易界,运输成本并不重要。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Goods, once they have been made, are assumed to move instantly and at no cost from place to place.
sentences.zh: 一旦货物生产,假定货物即刻、免费地从各地运到各地。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The real world, however, is full of frictions.
sentences.zh: 然而,现实世界充满了摩擦。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Cheap labour may make Chinese clothing competitive in America, but if delays in shipment tie up working capital and cause winter coats to arrive in spring, trade may lose its advantages.
sentences.zh: 廉价劳动力可能使中国服装在美国具有竞争力,但如果运输延误造成周转资本中断,导致冬季大衣在春季运抵,贸易就可能失去优势。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: C At the turn of the 20th century, agriculture and manufacturing were the two most important sectors almost everywhere, accounting for about 70% of total output in Germany, Italy and France, and 40-50% in America, Britain and Japan.
sentences.zh: C世纪初,农业和制造业几乎是各地最重要的两个部门,在德国、意大利和法国占总产出的70%,在美国、英国和日本占40-50%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: International commerce was therefore dominated by raw materials, such as wheat, wood and iron ore, or processed commodities, such as meat and steel.
sentences.zh: 因此,国际商业以小麦、木材和铁矿石等原材料或肉类和钢等加工商品为主。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But these sorts of products are heavy and bulky and the cost of transporting them relatively high.
sentences.zh: 但是,这些种类的产品是重重的,大宗的,运输成本相对较高。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: D Countries still trade disproportionately with their geographic neighbours.
sentences.zh: D国与其地理邻国的贸易仍然不成比例。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Over time, however, world output has shifted into goods whose worth is unrelated to their size and weight.
sentences.zh: 然而,随着时间的推移,世界产出已转向价值与其大小和重量无关的货物。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Today, it is finished manufactured products that dominate the flow of trade, and, thanks to technological advances such as lightweight components, manufactured goods themselves have tended to become lighter and less bulky.
sentences.zh: 今天,制成品是贸易流动的主要制成品,由于轻量级部件等技术进步,制成品本身往往变得较轻,体积较少。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: As a result, less transportation is required for every dollar’s worth of imports or exports.
sentences.zh: 因此,每美元进出口价值所需的运输量减少。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: E To see how this influences trade, consider the business of making disk drives for computers.
sentences.zh: 研究这如何影响贸易, 考虑为电脑制作磁盘驱动器的业务。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Most of the world’s disk-drive manufacturing is concentrated in South-east Asia.
sentences.zh: 世界大部分磁盘驱动制造集中在东南亚。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This is possible only because disk drives, while valuable, are small and light and so cost little to ship.
sentences.zh: 之所以能够做到这一点,是因为磁盘驱动器虽然价值巨大,但规模小,光线轻,对运输来说成本很小。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Computer manufacturers in Japan or Texas will not face hugely bigger freight bills if they import drives from Singapore rather than purchasing them on the domestic market.
sentences.zh: 日本或得克萨斯州的计算机制造商如果从新加坡进口驱动器而不是在国内市场上购买,就不会面临巨大的运费。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Distance therefore poses no obstacle to the globalisation of the disk-drive industry.
sentences.zh: 因此,距离对磁盘驱动工业的全球化没有障碍。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: F This is even more true of the fast-growing information industries.
sentences.zh: F对快速增长的信息产业来说更是如此。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

words.def: 信息信息信息信息信息信息信息

sentences.en: Films and compact discs cost little to transport, even by aeroplane.
sentences.zh: 电影和光盘的运输成本很小,甚至飞机运输成本也很低。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Computer software can be ‘exported’ without ever loading it onto a ship, simply by transmitting it over telephone lines from one country to another, so freight rates and cargo-handling schedules become insignificant factors in deciding where to make the product.
sentences.zh: 计算机软件可以 " 出口 ",而不必将其装船,只需从一国通过电话线将它传送到另一国,因此运费和货物处理时间表在决定产品生产地点时就变得微不足道。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Businesses can locate based on other considerations, such as the availability of labour, while worrying less about the cost of delivering their output.
sentences.zh: 企业可以基于其他考虑找到工作,如劳动力的提供,而较少担心产出的成本。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: G In many countries deregulation has helped to drive the process along.
sentences.zh: G 在许多国家,放松管制有助于推动这一进程。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But, behind the scenes, a series of technological innovations known broadly as containerisation and inter-modal transportation has led to swift productivity improvements in cargo-handling.
sentences.zh: 但是,在幕后,一系列技术革新,广泛称为集装箱化和多式联运,导致货物装卸的生产率迅速提高。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Forty years ago, the process of exporting or importing involved a great many stages of handling, which risked portions of the shipment being damaged or stolen along the way.
sentences.zh: 四十年前,进出口过程涉及许多处理阶段,这有可能使部分装运货物在途中受损或被盗。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The invention of the container crane made it possible to load and unload containers without capsizing the ship and the adoption of standard container sizes allowed almost any box to be transported on any ship.
sentences.zh: 集装箱起重机的发明使得在不给船舶封装的情况下装卸集装箱成为可能,而且标准集装箱尺寸的采用使任何船舶几乎可以运输任何箱。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: By 1967, dual-purpose ships, carrying loose cargo in the hold and containers on the deck, were giving way to all-container vessels that moved thousands of boxes at a time.
sentences.zh: 到1967年,两用船舶在货舱内载运散货和在甲板上装集装箱,让位于每次移动数千箱集装箱的所有集装箱船舶。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 双重用途的双重用途的双重用途

sentences.en: H The shipping container transformed ocean shipping into a highly efficient, intensely competitive business.
sentences.zh: H 海运集装箱将海运转变为高效、竞争激烈的商业。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But getting the cargo to and from the dock was a different story.
sentences.zh: 但把货物运到码头和从码头运出, 却是一个不同的故事。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: National governments, by and large, kept a much firmer hand on truck and railroad tariffs than on charges for ocean freight.
sentences.zh: 总的来说,各国政府对卡车和铁路关税比对海运费的关税保持了更强硬的手。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This started changing, however, in the mid-1970s, when America began to deregulate its transportation industry.
sentences.zh: 然而,在1970年代中期,美国开始放松对运输业的管制,这开始发生变化。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: First airlines, then road hauliers and railways, were freed from restrictions on what they could carry, where they could haul it and what price they could charge.
sentences.zh: 首先,航空公司,然后是公路运输商和铁路公司,已摆脱了对其可携带的物品、可运到何处以及可收取什么价格的限制。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Big productivity gains resulted.
sentences.zh: 生产率大增。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Between 1985 and 1996, for example, America’s freight railways dramatically reduced their employment, trackage, and their fleets of locomotives – while increasing the amount of cargo they hauled.
sentences.zh: 例如,1985年至1996年间,美国货运铁路大幅削减了他们的就业、跟踪和火车头车队,同时增加了他们所运输的货物数量。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Europe’s railways have also shown marked, albeit smaller, productivity improvements.
sentences.zh: 欧洲铁路也显示出显著的生产率提高,尽管这种提高较小。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: I In America the period of huge productivity gains in transportation may be almost over, but in most countries the process still has far to go.
sentences.zh: 在美洲,运输业生产力大幅提高的时期可能已几乎结束,但在大多数国家,这一进程仍然任重道远。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: State ownership of railways and airlines, regulation of freight rates and toleration of anti-competitive practices, such as cargo-handling monopolies, all keep the cost of shipping unnecessarily high and deter international trade.
sentences.zh: 国家对铁路和航空公司的所有权、对运费率的管制和对货物装卸垄断等反竞争做法的容忍,都使航运费用不必要地高,并阻碍国际贸易。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Bringing these barriers down would help the world’s economies grow even closer.
sentences.zh: 拆除这些障碍将有助于世界经济更接近增长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。
